$comment: Margin Agent plugin. Installing this file teaches Margin how to read 豆包 Agent Mode sessions. It contains no code: Margin validates it against the Agent Descriptor Spec and composes a reader from its own catalogue. See README.md for the install contract.
label: 豆包
$comment_home: Ordered candidates, resolved against the real filesystem at install time. The first that exists AND passes `probe` wins, so one file fits machines that keep 豆包 in different places.
$comment_capabilities: sessions and nothing else. `quota` and `handoff` are deliberately absent: quota needs a credential-bearing subscription endpoint and handoff needs a transcript distiller, neither of which the declarative catalogue can express. Declaring them without an implementation would be the silent half-wiring the spec rejects.

sessions.$comment_timestamps: The two native session files bracket the session's real span. Nothing the Agent wrote into its own scratch space may move the timestamps.
sessions.$comment_workspace: 豆包 does not record a working directory at all, so it is recovered from the absolute paths the transcript mentions. `parentOf` turns a file path into its directory; `requireMarker` prefers the candidate that actually looks like a project over an incidental path such as a bundled skill's reference file. The marker is a preference, never a filter — a session whose workspace has no .git still resolves to its first path.

$comment_probe: Structural check: does a candidate directory actually look like a 豆包 Agent Mode workspace? Without it, a mistyped path is indistinguishable from an Agent with no sessions.
